item.aqtweaks.spatial_rift_tear.name: Arcane Tunnel
item.aqtweaks.spatial_rift_tear.lore: §dPulls the arcane threads between places to open a temporary tunnel between them. Attune to a destination to open a rift back to that point.
item.aqtweaks.spatial_rift_tear.unbound: §7Unbound. Right-click in air to mark this place.
item.aqtweaks.spatial_rift_tear.shift: §8Sneak-use to rebind. Air-use opens a 60s rift at the bound point (any loaded dimension). Standing pets and leads follow; sitting pets stay.
item.aqtweaks.spatial_rift_tear.attuned: §5[Arcana]§r §dAttuned Arcane Tunnel to X: %d, Y: %d, Z: %d.
item.aqtweaks.spatial_rift_tear.missing_: §5[Arcana]§r The bound dimension is not loaded.
item.aqtweaks.spatial_rift_wild.name: Unstable Arcane Tunnel
item.aqtweaks.spatial_rift_wild.lore: §dDistorts arcane energy to open a tunnel between the current location and another random point in the same dimension.
item.aqtweaks.spatial_rift_wild.shift: §8Air-use opens a red rift pair 4000-6000 blocks away. Standing pets and leads follow; sitting pets stay.
entity.arcane_rift.name: Arcane Rift
